verdict.rationale: MX provides webhooks that send HTTPS POST callbacks to a URL of your choice when subscribed events occur, and the Client Dashboard lets you create, edit, test, and delete them. This is event notification only: any rule logic and resulting actions must be built in your own system, and there is no evidence of a native rules or trigger-action engine. Missing for 10: native rule definition (conditions → actions), built-in automated actions, any documented workflow/automation builder, independent corroboration of webhook reliability.
